# Plan a change

## Goal and users
What outcome matters, for whom, and why?

## Scope and boundaries
What is included and explicitly excluded?

## Acceptance criteria and examples
Give each observable criterion an identifier (for example, AC-1). Include important negative cases and invariants.

## Initial risk
Low / medium / high, with the reason.

## Implementation and verification plan
List likely areas to change, how each criterion will be verified, and material unresolved questions. Do not assume a particular technology before checking project decisions.

## Compatibility and recovery
Describe interface, data, operational, and external-effect impact, plus recovery limits.

## Plan revision and authorization
Identify the plan revision and the user's acceptance source. An AI-written issue field is not proof of approval.
